_doc: Town magic and research (Systems/Research.cs, sparks in Systems/Sparks.cs). Ideas appear from the town and the world: each discovery has sparks (craft:<profession>:<n> and folk:<race>:<n> name the newcomers behind them, partner:<people>, routes:<n>, building:<id>, tier:<charter>, book:<school>:<circle>, books:<n>, wizard:<level>, circle:<n>, hero:<class>[:level], heroes:<n>, found:<find kind>[:n] an explorers' find, slain:<creature type>[:n] what companies brought down at cleared sites, cleared:<tier>, delves:<n>, ally:<power>, known:<id>); once one has held brew[rank] days the idea is revealed, so every run's tree differs and grows with what the town meets. Requires must all hold to study it. Gold can't buy a study: lore a day comes from institutions, learned townsfolk, casters, books and the library's keeper, and insight brings lumps of lore from cleared sites, explorers' finds, new spellbooks, learned newcomers and drawn wizards. Funding only greases it (its lore multiplier) and is the council's gold sink.

discoveries.name: Tempered steel
discoveries.text: Quench and draw: blades and tools that hold an edge.

discoveries.name: Slate and lime
discoveries.text: Slate roofs, lime-washed timbers and buckets at every corner: a set fire smoulders and goes out. Stone buildings never burn at all.

discoveries.name: Deep delving
discoveries.text: Dwarven shoring and pumps take the quarries deeper.

discoveries.name: The fine loom
discoveries.text: A treadle loom that weaves twice as fine.

discoveries.name: Gnomish joinery
discoveries.text: Dovetails, glue and patience: furniture that outlasts its owners.

discoveries.name: Clockwork
discoveries.text: Springs and escapements: cranes that lift by themselves, a clock on the hall.

discoveries.name: The block press
discoveries.text: Carved blocks and a screw press: books by the dozen, not by the year.

discoveries.name: Three-field rotation
discoveries.text: Rest a field in three and the land stays sweet.

discoveries.name: Dykes and drains
discoveries.text: Lizardfolk know how to talk to wet ground.

discoveries.name: Hardy flocks
discoveries.text: Breeding from the frost-sworn's mountain sheep.

discoveries.name: The vintner's art
discoveries.text: Elven pruning and cool cellars.

discoveries.name: Hopped ale
discoveries.text: Bitter, clear and it keeps: the dwarves' way.

discoveries.name: Elven herb-lore
discoveries.text: Which leaf, which root, which moon to cut it under.

discoveries.name: Distillation
discoveries.text: The caravan lords' alembics: draughts twice as strong.

discoveries.name: Clean water
discoveries.text: Drains, cisterns and boiled water. Fewer fevers, cleaner sewers.

discoveries.name: Field surgery
discoveries.text: Templar surgeons teach the hall's healers to close a wound on the road.

discoveries.name: Bills of exchange
discoveries.text: A letter from a trusted house is as good as a chest of coin.

discoveries.name: Star charts
discoveries.text: Sailors' charts and the caravan lords' star tables: roads found by night.

discoveries.name: Guild charters
discoveries.text: Guilds that train apprentices and stand surety for their members.

discoveries.name: Pike drill
discoveries.text: Templars' drill: a wall of points the townsfolk can hold.

discoveries.name: Siegecraft
discoveries.text: Dwarf engineers' engines for the walls.

discoveries.name: Monster lore
discoveries.text: A bestiary from the reports of every company that came home.

discoveries.name: Grave wards
discoveries.text: Salt lines, grave-bells and the old names cut over the doors: what the companies learned from the dead they put back down.

discoveries.name: Beast craft
discoveries.text: Hides, horn and the habits of the wild things the companies hunted, turned to the flocks and the tanners.

discoveries.name: Dragonhide
discoveries.text: Scales off the beast a company brought down, riveted to leather: the town's best fighters go out half fireproof.

discoveries.name: Fey bargains
discoveries.text: Which gifts to leave at which stone, and which never to accept: the hedge and the hollow hills stop stealing children and start trading.

discoveries.name: Ledger cyphers
discoveries.text: Double entry and a merchant's cypher, learned from the town's friends among the great houses of coin.

discoveries.name: Fiend seals
discoveries.text: Circles drawn from the sigils on a slain fiend's hide: nothing called up from below crosses a sealed threshold.

discoveries.name: Binding the elements
discoveries.text: What the companies learned bringing down a raging spirit of earth or flame: the wizards bid lesser ones to haul stone and stoke kilns.

discoveries.name: The old histories
discoveries.text: Copied chronicles of the Age of Crowns: who ruled here, and what was buried.

discoveries.name: Hedge cantrips
discoveries.text: Small charms every apprentice learns: mending, lights, a clean hearth.

discoveries.name: Everburning lamps
discoveries.text: Flames that never go out on every corner and down every drain.

discoveries.name: Plant growth
discoveries.text: The wizards walk the fields at sowing, and the furrows overflow.

discoveries.name: Glyphs of warding
discoveries.text: Sigils on the grates and doors below: what comes up, burns.

discoveries.name: Fabrication
discoveries.text: Raw stone and timber shaped by a word into walls and beams.

discoveries.name: Teleportation circle
discoveries.text: A circle of silver in the hall: merchants and settlers step through from far cities.

discoveries.name: Guards and wards
discoveries.text: The whole town woven into one warding: fog in the lanes, locked doors, webs on the stairs.

discoveries.name: The heroes' feast
discoveries.text: A table conjured each new moon: who eats there fears nothing for a month.

discoveries.name: Weather-working
discoveries.text: Rain when the farms need rain, sun at harvest.

discoveries.name: The great working
discoveries.text: One spell to remake the town's fortune, cast once in a lifetime.

discoveries.name: War-drums of the Tide
discoveries.text: The orc hosts' drum-calls, learned the hard way: sallies move as one, and raiders hear the town coming.

discoveries.name: Stoneking masonry
discoveries.text: How the giant kings cut whole mountains: interlocking blocks no ram can shift.

discoveries.name: Rime-forging
discoveries.text: Frost-giant cold-iron and ice-cellars: the winter stores keep, the steel holds an edge.

discoveries.name: Grave-bell liturgy
discoveries.text: Bells cast with grave-dirt and the names of the dead: the restless lie down, and the living sleep.

discoveries.name: Coil antivenoms
discoveries.text: The serpent-priests' poisons, turned: a cure for every bite and a remedy for every fever of the fens.

discoveries.name: Drowned charts
discoveries.text: Soundings and safe channels from the drowned and the corsairs: caravans and ships go where they used to wreck.

discoveries.name: Fey courtesy
discoveries.text: Which name never to give, which cup never to drink: the hollow court's games turn to bargains.

discoveries.name: Counter-hymns
discoveries.text: The choir's song sung backwards in every temple: the dread it spreads finds no purchase.

discoveries.name: Brimstone alchemy
discoveries.text: The regents' ash and sulphur, mastered: stronger draughts, and fire-pots for the walls.

discoveries.name: Heraldic law
discoveries.text: Every claim, every bloodline, written down and sealed: no pretender's word unsettles the town again.

discoveries.name: Rootspeech
discoveries.text: What the old wild says through its roots: where to sow, when the blight is coming.

discoveries.name: Lower-court contracts
discoveries.text: Clause by clause, how the lower courts write a bargain, and where the loopholes are.

discoveries.name: Door-sealing
discoveries.text: Seals and wardings from the last door: what lies under the streets stays there.

discoveries.name: Vermilion wards
discoveries.text: The Conclave's red sigils on every gate: hexes slide off and walls stand harder.

discoveries.name: Lantern code
discoveries.text: The Lanternbearers' shuttered signals from hill to hill: every blow is seen coming.

discoveries.name: False books
discoveries.text: Two ledgers for every coffer, the Black Ledger's way: richer, and whispered about.

discoveries.name: Quiet poisons
discoveries.text: The Silent Knife's craft in the watch's hands: a knife in the dark answered with one.

discoveries.name: Ember firebrands
discoveries.text: Dragonfire caught in clay, a gift of the Ember Court: hurled from the walls, it stops a host cold.

discoveries.name: Bottled weather
discoveries.text: A hag's jar of rain and one of sun: the bad season is uncorked somewhere else.

discoveries.name: Beacon chain
discoveries.text: A fire on every hill from here to the League's cities: help rides out the same night.

discoveries.name: Lamplight lenses
discoveries.text: Ground crystal from the deep workings: light in the mines, sharper eyes in the scrying bowl.

discoveries.name: Longship lines
discoveries.text: Clinker hulls and the jarls' star-paths: longer runs, fewer wrecks.

discoveries.name: Deep wells
discoveries.text: The oasis heirs' wells and cisterns: no siege or drought makes the town thirst.
